title: NH3/O3 gas monomer frequency and stability verification
new_evaluations: SCF+grad 2/2; stability 2/2; analytic Hessian 2/2; D2 FD checks 4 (not SCF)
method: wb97xd(libxc)+project -D2 full derivative / def2-TZVP / L8 / grid_response / SCF 1e-12,1e-9, gas

stability.scope: internal only; no external search/following/UKS; internal stability does NOT exclude multireference

hessian.composition: combined (analytic DFT + central-FD D2 of analytic D2 gradient); DFT part = combined - D2; NOT called fully analytic; no double counting
hessian.layout: (natm,natm,3,3) -> transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(3n,3n); matches PySCF thermo convention (022 lesson applied)

frequencies.projection: mass-weighted standard TR basis (rank 6 for both, nonlinear); orthogonality max dev <= 1.1e-15
frequencies.cross_check_scope: validates matrix handling and mass conventions ONLY

verdict.NH3: local minimum SUPPORTED within this batch method and check scope
verdict.O3: local minimum SUPPORTED within this batch method and check scope
verdict.scope: this batch method (wb97xd+-D2/def2-TZVP/L8, gas) and checks (internal stability + harmonic frequencies); multireference not excluded (O3); no enthalpy/free energy/rates/binding energy; gas results are NOT aquaculture-mechanism interpretations
